meta.name: discover
meta.description: Trace a customer workflow and identify the problem, baseline and evidence gaps. Use for discovery or an unclear customer brief, before choosing a solution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊的客户需求理成清楚的问题、基线与证据清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户只丢来一句模糊需求,还没想清到底要解决什么。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague customer brief into a clear problem, baseline and evidence list
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a customer brief is vague and you must pin down the real problem first.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会追踪客户的工作流,找出问题、基线(gap 前的现状值)和证据缺口,供你在定方案前参考。它从你给的上下文直接开工,不重开已答过的调研。
howto.when: 当任务属于 discovery(发现调研)、客户需求描述不清楚,或还没定方案需要先摸清情况时接管;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前范围和已答问题。

say.text: 帮我追踪这家客户的工作流,指出问题、基线和证据缺口。
say.note: 进入 discovery 梳理流程。

say.text: 客户的需求描述不清楚,先做一轮 discovery。
say.note: 定方案前先把范围问清。

say.text: 把这次调研里还没确认的未知项列出来。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude traces a customer workflow and identifies the problem, baseline and evidence gaps before you pick a solution. It works from the supplied context and won't restart discovery already answered.
howto.when_en: Triggers for discovery work or an unclear customer brief, before choosing a solution. When called by @fde it reuses that packet and scope.

say_en.text: Trace this customer's workflow; find the problem, baseline and evidence gaps.
The customer brief is unclear — run a discovery pass first.
say_en.note: Clarifies scope before picking a solution.

say_en.text: List the unknowns still open from this discovery.
